query.description: Optional substring search against platform name and metric.

sector.description: Optional sector filter (e.g. app-stores, games, creator, templates, freelance, ecommerce, developer-marketplaces).

costLines.description: Unit cost lines consumed per sale.

supplyId.description: Supply-chain unit-cost row id from list_supply_costs.

feeSupplyIds.description: Optional selling-fee row ids from list_supply_costs (e.g. polar-starter-fee, gumroad-direct-fee).

priceUsd.description: Hypothesis selling price in USD (must be > 0; treated as a price hypothesis, not a demand claim).

takeRateFrom.description: Optional economy row id from search_digital_economies with a confirmed takeRateFraction.
